fields.description: Daily OT cap. Leave 0 for no cap.
fields.label: Maximum Overtime Hours Allowed Per Day

fields.description: Earning component OT is paid through (e.g. OverTime Allowance).
fields.label: Overtime Salary Component

fields.description: Gross Pay Based = gross_pay / days / hours. Salary Component Based = selected component / days / hours. Fixed Hourly Rate = flat rate.
fields.label: Overtime Amount Calculation
fields.options:
Gross Pay Based
Salary Component Based
Fixed Hourly Rate

fields.description: Monthly salary divided by this to get per-day.
fields.label: Days Divisor (Days in Month)

fields.description: Last-resort fallback, used only when the shift has no start/end time. Category Rules take precedence, then the shift's end_time minus start_time.
fields.label: Standard Daily Hours

fields.description: Default unpaid break. Used for employees with no matching Category Rule, and as the break for a rule that ticks Deduct Break without giving hours.
fields.label: Break Time (Hours)

fields.description: If checked, use a separate multiplier on public holidays.
fields.label: Apply for Public Holiday

fields.description: If checked, use a separate multiplier on weekends.
fields.label: Apply for Weekend

fields.description: Role required to approve/submit Employee Overtime.
fields.label: OverTime Approver

fields.description: Extra time must cross this before any overtime is earned. 30 minutes by default, so an 8 hour shift earns OT from 8:30 onwards - and the whole extra span is then paid, not just the part past the grace.
fields.label: Overtime Grace Period (Minutes)

fields.description: Standard hours and break deduction per employee category and shift length. The shift length is matched from Shift Type end time minus start time; the matched row's Shift Hours is also the divisor used for the hourly rate. Employees with no category, or a shift length no row matches, fall back to the shift length and the break above.
fields.label: Category Rules

fields.description: A single IN to OUT span longer than this is treated as a bad punch pair (a missed OUT, an overnight anomaly) and is ignored. Leave 0 to use the built-in 16 hour default.
fields.label: Maximum Shift Span (Hours)
Pull Records
fields.description: Tick to backfill overtime for a date range, set the dates below, then Save. Records are created for eligible check-ins between the two dates. The box clears itself after the run.
